astra-high.main_disposition: Accepted: low-severity directory-pattern scope concern is covered by the Git-compatibility brief and verified against native Git; no introduced P0/P1.

astra-xhigh.main_disposition: Accepted after native Git scope replay. Markdown-formatted verdict produced a conservative warn sidecar, not automatic acceptance.

sol-xhigh.main_disposition: Accepted: no introduced P0/P1; all directory-pattern extensions meet the Git-compatibility brief. The last path-containment candidate additionally fixes the inherited dot-free escape.

gitignore_scope_replay.derivation: All nine actual candidate post-image ASTs equal the tested reference plus common directory-basename guard extension. Patches applied in memory to the injected mutation.

inherited_findings.description: Current source accepts dot-free absolute paths outside an explicit base. Reproduced; inherited, not introduced. Sol's final path-containment candidate also fixes it.

main_integrator_observation.scope: Mixed integration work, not attributable to individual benchmark tasks

limits: Small fixed mutation battery; not general reliability or high-severity review-retention proof.
Concurrent runs on one host; aggregate task time is not fleet makespan or a causal latency estimate.
One aggregated turn.completed usage event per task. Per-request context unavailable because executions were ephemeral; costs are Standard-equivalent lower/upper bounds, not invoices.
Main-integration turns per benchmark cell were not instrumented; no counts imputed from token share.
Astra reviews were sealed and static; Sol review was by the main integrator after grader results were visible.
The harness INCONCLUSIVE label concerns its baseline-vs-tldrs-condition comparison, not model task failure; only baseline condition was intentionally run.
